Wangari Genesis Gift Set Hamper – Premium Sustainable Corporate Gifting Solution

The Wangari Genesis Gift Set Hamper is a thoughtfully curated premium gifting solution designed for modern corporate, festive, and employee appreciation needs. Crafted with sustainability, innovation, and elegance in mind, this exclusive hamper blends eco-friendly materials with smart lifestyle products, making it ideal for gifting on occasions such as corporate events, conferences, festivals, onboarding programs, and brand promotions.

This premium gift showcases a perfect balance of technology, design, and environmental responsibility. Each item is carefully selected to enhance everyday usability while reinforcing your brand’s commitment to sustainable gifting solutions.

What’s Inside the Wangari Genesis Gift Set Hamper

  • Wangari Aspen QI 10000mAh Power Bank with 15W Wireless Charger – A high-capacity wireless power bank designed for fast and efficient charging. Compatible with Qi-enabled smartphones, this power bank ensures uninterrupted productivity on the go, making it a popular choice in corporate tech gifts.
  • Wangari Custom 3D Printed Desk Lamp – Elegantly designed using Polylactic Acid (PLA), a biodegradable and eco-conscious material. This modern desk lamp adds aesthetic appeal to workspaces while promoting eco-friendly office décor.
  • Wangari Custom Table Top Calendar 2025 – A practical and stylish desktop accessory that keeps important dates organized throughout the year. Perfect for daily visibility and long-term brand recall.
  • Eco Friendly Diary – Made with recycled fabric and handmade paper, this diary is 100% tree-free and acid-free. Ideal for professionals who value sustainability, mindful writing, and premium stationery.
  • Wooden Finish Ball Pen with Stylus and Ruler – A multifunctional pen featuring a smooth-writing refill, touchscreen stylus, and ruler printed on the body. A smart addition to eco-conscious office supplies.
  • 500 ml Glass Bottle with Silicone Sleeve – Reusable and durable glass bottle designed for everyday hydration. The protective silicone sleeve ensures safety, while the bamboo finish cap enhances the natural, premium appeal.

Why Choose

The stands out as a sustainable alternative to traditional gift hampers. It aligns perfectly with current trends in eco-friendly corporate gifting, offering products that are reusable, biodegradable, and responsibly sourced. Whether you are looking for corporate gift in India, premium festive gifts, or sustainable employee welcome kits, this delivers long-lasting value while enhancing brand perception.

Key Benefits

  • Premium eco-friendly gift hamper with modern lifestyle essentials
  • Supports sustainable gifting and environmental responsibility
  • Ideal for corporate events, festivals, employee rewards, and client gifting
  • High utility products ensure daily brand visibility
  • Custom branding options available for bulk corporate gifting

Ideal Use Cases

The is suitable for a wide range of occasions including corporate anniversaries, Diwali and festive gifting, employee onboarding kits, client appreciation gifts, sustainability campaigns, and promotional giveaways. With the inclusion of high-demand items like the Wangari Aspen QI 10000mAh power bank with 15W wireless charger and eco-conscious stationery, this ensures both practicality and premium appeal.

Sustainable Gifting with Lasting Impact

Choosing the reflects a commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability. From the custom 3D printed desk lamp made of Polylactic Acid to the eco-friendly diary with handmade paper, every element reinforces responsible consumption.

Elevate your corporate gifting strategy with a premium, eco-conscious solution that resonates with today’s environmentally aware professionals. The is more than a gift—it’s a statement of purpose, style, and sustainability.
